text: Yahweh’s Greatness Is UnsearchableA Praise of David.א AlephI will exalt You, my God, O King,And I will bless Your name forever and ever.
ב BethEvery day I will bless You,And I will praise Your name forever and ever.
ג GimelGreat is Yahweh, and highly to be praised,And His greatness is unsearchable.
ד DalethOne generation shall laud Your works to another,And shall declare Your mighty deeds.
ה HeOn the glorious splendor of Your majestyAnd on the words of Your wondrous deeds, I will muse.
ו VavMen shall speak of the strength of Your fearsome acts,And I will recount Your greatness.
ז ZayinThey shall pour forth the memory of Your abundant goodnessAnd will shout joyfully of Your righteousness.
ח HethYahweh is gracious and compassionate;Slow to anger and great in lovingkindness.
ט TethYahweh is good to all,And His compassions are over all His works.
י YodhAll Your works, O Yahweh, shall give thanks to You,And Your holy ones shall bless You.
כ KaphThey shall speak of the glory of Your kingdomAnd talk of Your might;
ל LamedhTo make known to the sons of men His mighty deedsAnd the glory of the majesty of His kingdom.
מ MemYour kingdom is an everlasting kingdom,And Your dominion endures from generation to every generation.
ס SamekhYahweh sustains all who fallAnd raises up all who are bowed down.
ע AyinThe eyes of all wait on You,And You give them their food in due time.
פ PeYou open Your handAnd satisfy the desire of every living thing.
צ TsadheYahweh is righteous in all His waysAnd holy in all His works.
ק QophYahweh is near to all who call upon Him,To all who call upon Him in truth.
ר ReshHe will work out the desire of those who fear Him;He will hear their cry for help and He will save them.
שׁ ShinYahweh keeps all who love Him,But all the wicked He will destroy.
ת TavMy mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh,And all flesh will bless His holy name forever and ever.
